claimed: baselines predict half B of the held-out cells
actual: model predicts the full-data mean shift
note: The model's target is LESS noisy than the baselines' target, so model R2 and baseline R2 are not on one scale. The constants 0.129 / 0.226 hard-coded in cb_train.py came from the half-B evaluation.
